name: Quest Start
lines: The story begins in the night nursery in London. Open the book and press Begin: it takes you there.
The Tales of Kassel
The tales begin at the inn at Kassel, October 1812. Open the book and press Begin.
The old stories begin with the Sibyl at the Vestibule, at the top of the long stair down. Open the book and press Begin.
The Extraordinary Voyages
Verne's own stories, walked. Open the book and press Begin: it takes you to the first one.
Shakespeare's own life. Begins at the Folio Library, Stationers' Hall, by St Paul's.
Peter Pan in Kensington Gardens
Begins at the Black Lion Gate, Bayswater Road, a summer afternoon in 1912.
Westminster and the Second Stain
Begins on Westminster Bridge at dawn.
Begins in the rooms at 221B.
Seven, Saville Row
Begins at No. 7, Saville Row, Mr. Phileas Fogg's house, 1872.
Begins at the Chestnuts, Streatham.
Begins with a stranger in Spitalfields, Friday 31 August 1888.
The journey begins at Manaos, on the Rio Negro. Open the book and press Begin.
The tales begin with The Raven: midnight, in bleak December. Open the book and press Begin.

Your story is already under way. Open the Oz card and press 📖 The chapters: it says where you are and what to do next.
Stevenson's whole book begins at the Admiral Benbow inn, with the old sea-dog. Open the book and press Begin. (Your ship and the open sea are yours to sail too.)

The story starts in the Far Reach: go through the Far Gate past Pluto, then turn round: a raider wreck drifts about 9 km behind the gate, further out from the two suns. Fly to it and scan it. Your Star Log always shows where to go next.
You arrive in Florence. The card lists the lessons, the riddles and the machines, and where each one is.
Start in the Gatehouse Court, where you came in (it is safe). The card shows the maze's halls, the Deep and what to look for.
The tale goes chapter by chapter. Open its card: the arrow shows the chapter to play now.
